title: Homework: reopen the crosswind claim
brief: The trainer must now address a 6 m/s crosswind with 20 m/s runway-axis airspeed. Chapter geometry gives a 16.7° crab angle; this is not a rudder command. Complete all twelve sections. For a LOCAL TEACHING EXERCISE ONLY, use synthetic CnBeta=0.10/rad, beta=0.08 rad, Cn0=0 and CnRudder=-0.08/rad, with rudder limits ±0.12 rad. This beta is an independent sideslip scenario, not a conversion of the crab angle. Use CnBeta*beta+CnRudder*deltaR+Cn0=0. No roll, lateral-force, gust, de-crab, tire, clearance or workload model is supplied. Explain crab versus sideslip/de-crab, identify missing evidence and stakeholder consequences, and decide whether the operational crosswind claim is supported. Implement calculate(input) returning -(CnBeta*beta+Cn0)/CnRudder in rad. Require finite numeric inputs and nonzero CnRudder. Throw Error for invalid inputs. This local yaw balance cannot establish crosswind controllability.
